recent_fixbook.symptom: a release could die on a PermissionError traceback and still have printed that it saved
recent_fixbook.cause: save() logged the success line before writing, and neither it nor publish_public() caught the write error, so an unattended job exited on a traceback and main() returned 0 either way
recent_fixbook.fix: both report whether they wrote, neither claims a save it cannot prove, and main() exits non-zero when either write failed
recent_fixbook.detects: audit_selftest.py makes the state file read-only and checks there is no traceback, a non-zero exit, and no claim of a save

recent_fixbook.symptom: every runner started its token allowance from the last runner's usage
recent_fixbook.cause: the Friday job's blanket git add committed data/token_usage.json. It is live rate-limit state for whichever machine is running, so each later run on another runner read a total it had not earned
recent_fixbook.fix: the file is ignored along with the temporary files the atomic writes leave behind, so a blanket add cannot sweep up live state again
recent_fixbook.detects: checked by hand: a blanket git add -A in a copy of the tree leaves no token_usage.json staged, verified by cleanroom_selftest.py
